name: The Shop
note: Resale shop on Santa Cruz Avenue in downtown Menlo Park selling donated clothing, accessories, and household goods, with proceeds supporting the Junior League of Palo Alto-Mid Peninsula. The Shop was established in 1970 and operates at 725 Santa Cruz Avenue.

name: Afterwards
note: Designer consignment shop selling women's clothing, handbags, shoes, furnishings and artwork in downtown Menlo Park. It opened in September 1990 and remains open.

name: Menlo Park Academy of Dance
note: Dance studio in downtown Menlo Park. It began in 1947 at another El Camino Real address, moved to 1163 El Camino Real in 1949, took its current name in 1969, and remains open.

name: Sultana
note: Turkish and Mediterranean restaurant near El Camino Real and Santa Cruz Avenue, established in 2006 according to the restaurant itself. A Palo Alto Online review published June 30, 2006 already lists it at 1149 El Camino Real, and it remains open daily.

name: Oak + Violet
note: Restaurant inside the Park James Hotel that opened for dinner on October 8, 2018. The hotel dining page still lists current dinner hours and reservations.

name: Luminaire
note: Modern furniture and design showroom on Santa Cruz Avenue in downtown Menlo Park. A January 2022 Modern Luxury article announced the new Menlo Park showroom opening that spring, and Luminaire's current showroom page lists 870 Santa Cruz Ave.

name: Guapas Mexican Grill
note: A Menlo Park school newspaper article published in November 2023 reports that the restaurant opened its Menlo Park doors on September 20 after a South San Francisco opening that February. Current listings still show the Mexican restaurant operating at 515 El Camino Real.

name: Hotel Lucent
note: Boutique hotel at 727 El Camino Real in Menlo Park, created through a comprehensive renovation of an existing hotel. It was operating under the Hotel Lucent name by fall 2015, when guest reviews described newly renovated rooms, and its official site still lists the hotel at this address.

name: Fey Restaurant
note: Sichuan restaurant on El Camino Real in Menlo Park. A local profile says the Menlo Park location opened in 2012, and current dining listings still show it open at 1368 El Camino Real.

name: Residence Inn Palo Alto Menlo Park
note: Extended-stay Marriott hotel with 138 suites on Glenwood Avenue near downtown Menlo Park. It opened in spring 2015 and is still operating.

name: FedEx Office
note: Print and ship center on El Camino Real in Menlo Park. A June 1995 local column lists a Kinko's copy shop at this address, and FedEx still operates its print and ship center there.

name: Menlo Park Fire District Station 6
note: Downtown fire station first built on this site in 1953. The old building was torn down in late 2016 and replaced by a larger station, which crews moved into in June 2018 and which still serves downtown Menlo Park.

name: Guy Plumbing and Heating
note: A family-owned plumbing business with a showroom at 1265 El Camino Real in Menlo Park has operated in Menlo Park since 1948. It remains open at the same address.

name: Sugar Shack
note: Candy shop on Santa Cruz Avenue in downtown Menlo Park. A 2019 student newspaper account says the Sugar Shack originally opened in 2007 and closed in 2014, and Palo Alto Online placed the shop at 816 Santa Cruz Ave before its closure.

name: Una Mas Mexican Grill
note: Mexican grill on Santa Cruz Avenue in downtown Menlo Park. Palo Alto Online reported in December 2019 that the restaurant at 683 Santa Cruz Ave had closed after operating there since 1994.

name: Ann's Coffee Shop
note: Diner on Santa Cruz Avenue in downtown Menlo Park. The Menlo Park Historical Association says the coffee shop relocated to 772 Santa Cruz Avenue about 1962 and closed in 2021 after its building was sold.

name: Golden Shears
note: Barber shop opened by Louis Arenas in 1963. It closed on January 10, 2016, after 53 years in downtown Menlo Park.

name: LB Steak
note: Steakhouse at the corner of Santa Cruz Avenue and University Drive in downtown Menlo Park. Palo Alto Online reported the restaurant at 898 Santa Cruz Ave opened in July 2012 and closed in April 2018 after about six years.

name: Left Bank Brasserie
note: French brasserie that opened in 1998 as the Menlo Park branch of a restaurant founded in Larkspur. It closed in June 2026 when its parent company shut all of its Bay Area restaurants.

name: First Church of Christ, Scientist
note: Church on Ravenswood Avenue in Menlo Park. Its history page says the present site at 201 Ravenswood Avenue was acquired in 1957 and first services in the first building there were held in April 1958; its current site lists services at the same address.

name: Foster's Freeze
note: Soft-serve ice cream and hamburger stand on Oak Grove Avenue near El Camino Real in Menlo Park. The Menlo Park Historical Association says it first appears in Polk directories at 580 Oak Grove in 1950, and a student newspaper reported its closing in October 2015.

name: Su Hong To Go
note: Takeout Chinese restaurant on Menlo Avenue in downtown Menlo Park. Palo Alto Online reported it opened at 630 Menlo Ave in 1991 and that the Su Hong name ended there on September 30, 2015 when the restaurant changed hands and name.

name: Gambardella's
note: Italian restaurant across from the Menlo Park Caltrain station. A 2004 Palo Alto Online review says Gambardella's reopened in November 2003 in the Menlo Square building at 1165 Merrill St, and a 2014 article says it closed in December 2012.

name: Bradley's Fine Diner
note: American diner from chef Bradley Ogden, known as BFD, across from the Menlo Park Caltrain station. Palo Alto Online reported it opened in November 2014 and had closed as of January 1, 2017.

name: Peet's Coffee
note: Peet's second store, after the original in Berkeley, opened in 1971 at the corner of Santa Cruz Avenue and University Drive. It briefly closed after a nearby fire in March 2009 and reopened that month.

name: Mountain Mike's
note: Pizza restaurant at the corner of El Camino Real and Menlo Avenue, opened in 2019 as a Mountain Mike's franchise in the former longtime Applewood Pizza space.

name: Kyosho

name: Anthem Bed & Bath

note: Open today (supermarket). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Menlo Park Central Library
note: Menlo Park's main public library opened in 1957 in a new single-story building at the Laurel Street civic center, after voters approved a bond in 1956. The city still runs its main library here.

name: Menlo Park Presbyterian Church
note: The congregation was founded in 1873 and met at 700 Santa Cruz Avenue for 76 years before moving to this Santa Cruz Avenue campus at Johnson Street in 1950. It is still active here today and is now known as Menlo Church.

name: Draeger's Market
note: Family supermarket that Frank Draeger opened around 1955 near Santa Cruz Avenue and University Drive, six years after the family's first store in San Mateo. It was expanded around 1990 and is still open today.

name: U.S. Bank
note: Open today (bank). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Chef Kwan's Cafe
note: Chinese takeout restaurant that took the Chef Kwan's name in fall 2015, when new owner Jason Kwan bought Su Hong To Go, which had been at this address since 1991. It kept the Su Hong menu and is still open today.

name: Jeffrey's Hamburgers
note: Retro diner-style hamburger restaurant that opened in fall 2007 in the former Henry's Steak House space on El Camino Real. Still open today.

name: Menlo Park Police Department
note: Open today (police). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Arrillaga Family Recreation Center
note: City recreation center on the civic center campus that offers classes and rentable meeting rooms. It was renovated with donations from developer John Arrillaga and has carried his family's name since about 2011.

name: McDonald's
note: Open today (fast food). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Oak Grove Station Menlo Park Post Office
note: Menlo Park's post office moved into this building in 1961, after earlier locations including 560 Oak Grove Ave. It became a branch, Oak Grove Station, once the Bohannon Drive post office opened in 1962, and it is still open.

name: Guild
note: Opened in 1926 as the Menlo Theatre and was renamed the Guild in the late 1940s. It stopped showing films in 2019 and reopened in 2022 as a live music venue.

name: LeatherLeather
note: Family-owned leather and fabric furniture showroom, open at this address since 2003 according to the business.

name: A-A Lock
note: Open today (locksmith). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: First Republic Bank
note: First Republic Bank branch near Oak Grove Avenue; building permits for its sign and remodel were issued in late 1997. The bank failed in May 2023, and city records later describe the building as a vacant former bank.

name: M&R Automotive
note: Auto repair shop on El Camino Real that says it has been in business since 1968. San Mateo County lists it at this address as a used motor oil drop-off site.

name: Naomi Sushi
note: Japanese sushi restaurant on El Camino Real that opened in fall 1997, first under the name Naomi Sushi Pasta Grill. It closed abruptly in July 2024 for what a door notice called renovations, and has not been reported as reopening.

name: Fey Restaurant
note: Open today (restaurant). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Jason's Cafe
note: Breakfast and lunch cafe that opened on El Camino Real in 2008 and closed in May 2019. It reopened at the same address in 2023.

name: Relax The Back
note: Store selling back-care products and ergonomic furniture on El Camino Real. A local shopping column listed it at this address in May 1995, and it still operates there.

name: FedEx Office
note: Open today (copyshop). Listed in OpenStreetMap; the year it opened isn't known yet.

name: West Bay Model Railroad Association
note: A model railroad club founded in 1947. It has been in the former Railway Express Agency depot at the Menlo Park train station since 1950, and it holds free public open houses there.

name: 7-Eleven
note: Convenience store that was already open by June 2002, when a fire badly damaged it and a Chinese restaurant in the same building. It is still open at this address.

name: Holy Trinity Episcopal Church
note: The parish's 1886 chapel was moved to Pine Street near Ravenswood Avenue in 1947, and a new church was built on Ravenswood at Laurel Street in 1957. The church is still active here and now calls itself Trinity Church in Menlo Park.

name: Drunken Monk
note: Japanese izakaya known for sake and charcoal-grilled yakitori, opened October 1, 2023 in the former Gombei restaurant space. Still open.

name: J&J Hawaiian Barbeque
note: Hawaiian plate-lunch restaurant, listed at this address in a March 2005 Metro guide and still open today; its exact opening year is unknown.

name: The UPS Store
note: Shipping, printing and mailbox store (The UPS Store #865), open today at 405 El Camino Real. The year it opened isn't known yet.

name: Round Table Pizza
note: The first Round Table Pizza opened on December 21, 1959, at 1235 El Camino Real in a former water company building. After 1978 the founder rebuilt one door down at 1225 El Camino Real, where the restaurant is still open.

name: Safeway
note: Supermarket listed at this El Camino Real location in the 1955 city directory; Safeway had been in Menlo Park since at least 1937 at 1137 El Camino Real. The original store was later torn down and replaced with a new building, and it is still open.

name: Nativity of the Holy Virgin Orthodox Church
note: The 1886 chapel, originally Holy Trinity Episcopal Church, was given to the Orthodox parish, moved to Crane Street in October 1957 and consecrated in May 1958. The church is still active here.

name: Arrillaga Family Gymnastics Center
note: City-run gymnastics center at Burgess Park on the civic center campus, paid for with donations from developer John Arrillaga's family. It held its grand opening on May 11, 2012, and reopened in February 2026 after storm flooding closed it.

name: Park James
note: 61-room boutique hotel on El Camino Real that opened in late September 2018, with the Oak + Violet restaurant opening inside in October. It is still operating.

name: Saint Frank Coffee
note: Outdoor coffee kiosk from the San Francisco roaster, across from the Menlo Park Caltrain station. It opened on August 19, 2019 as a required public benefit of the Alma Station office development.
